mapper.select: SELECT task.* FROM sys_tenant_access_publish_task task WHERE ((task.status = 'PENDING' AND task.next_attempt_at_ms <= #{nowMs}) OR (task.status = 'PROCESSING' AND task.lease_until_ms < #{nowMs})) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_tenant_access_publish_task active WHERE active.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND active.status = 'PROCESSING' AND active.lease_until_ms >= #{nowMs} AND active.id <> task.id ) ORDER BY task.seq ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_tenant_access_publish_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND seq > #{seq}
SELECT * FROM sys_tenant_access_publish_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1
